input.sql:
SELECT        AUFK.AUFNR AS [Process Order #], 
                TJ02T.TXT04 AS [System Status]
FROM sap.JEST AS JEST
INNER JOIN sap.JSTO AS JSTO
ON JEST.OBJNR = JSTO.OBJNR
AND JEST.CHGNR = JSTO.CHGNR
INNER JOIN sap.TJ02 AS TJ02 ON TJ02.ISTAT = JEST.STAT
INNER JOIN sap.TJ02T ON JEST.STAT = TJ02T.ISTAT
INNER JOIN sap.AUFK ON AUFK.OBJNR = JEST.OBJNR
WHERE AUFK.AUFNR = '000#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"foreach","line":"4262daff","path":["d4eb7f5e_825c_4d26_845c_c249964bcb0c"]}')}'        
AND TJ02T.SPRAS = 'E'                                --CONSTANT FOR ENGLISH                                        
AND JEST.INACT = ''                                        --CONSTANT FOR Indicator: Status Is Inactive
AND TJ02.NODIS = ''                                        --CONSTANT FOR 'Do not display status' flag        
AND TJ02.SETONLY = ''                                --CONSTANT FOR 'Status can only be set' flag
AND TJ02T.TXT04 IN ('CNF', 'TECO')

block.name: run_custom_sql

input.sql:
SELECT 
MSEG.VBELN_IM AS [DELIV_NUM],
LIPS.POSNR AS  [DELIV_ITEM],
LIPS.UMVKZ AS [FACT_UNIT_NOM],
LIPS.UMVKN AS [FACT_UNIT_DENOM],
LIPS.UMREV AS [CONV_FACT]
FROM sap.MSEG AS MSEG
INNER JOIN sap.LIPS AS LIPS
ON MSEG.VBELN_IM = LIPS.VBELN
AND MSEG.VBELP_IM = LIPS.POSNR
WHERE MSEG.MBLNR = '#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"sap","line":"d085b308","path":["response_data","MATERIALDOCUMENT"]}')}'
input.output_schema: [{"control_type":"text","label":"DELIV NUM","name":"DELIV NUM","type":"string","optional":false,"hint":"DELIV NUM"},{"control_type":"text","label":"DELIV ITEM","name":"DELIV ITEM","type":"string","optional":false,"hint":"DELIV ITEM"},{"control_type":"text","label":"FACT UNIT NOM","name":"FACT UNIT NOM","type":"string","optional":false,"hint":"FACT UNIT NOM"},{"control_type":"text","label":"FACT UNIT DENOM","name":"FACT UNIT DENOM","type":"string","optional":false,"hint":"FACT UNIT DENOM"},{"control_type":"text","label":"CONV FACT","name":"CONV FACT","type":"string","optional":false,"hint":"CONV FACT"}]

LIPS.POSNR AS  [DELIV_ITEM],

input.sql:
SELECT aufnr AS [Process Order #],
		 rueck AS [CONFIRMATION],
         rmzhl AS [CONFIRMATIONCOUNTER],
         lmnga AS [Quantity]
    FROM sap.afru
   WHERE aufnr = '000#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"foreach","line":"a1320275","path":["d4eb7f5e_825c_4d26_845c_c249964bcb0c"]}')}' --[Replace with Process Order #]
     AND stokz = ''				--CONSTANT for Not Reversed
     AND stzhl = '00000000'	--CONSTANT for Not Cancelled
	ORDER BY lmnga ASC

extended_input_schema.hint: First provide the full name assigned to your bind variable in the WHERE condition. e.g. id Second, provide the actual parameter value. Parameter values can be static or datapills. Select the closest corresponding data type that your database is expecting for the bind variable This feature requires OPA version 2.7.3 or newer
